ruling: You may use abilities on any opponent's cards (static, all opponents). The borrowed ability resolves as if the card's controller activated it (that player is 'controller' for the block), but you pay numeric costs from your own resources. Inside the borrowed block, 'opponent' is bound to the Billionaire's controller (the real user), so the 2-player relationship is preserved; no extra prompt.
